programme.title: Powerfull Yoddha
programme.desc: Chandu is very passionate about kickboxing and his life revolves around his mother and his girlfriend. His life is shattered when his dying mother asks him to meet his estranged father Raghuveer.

programme.title: Aar Ya Paar
programme.desc: Shekhar is having an affair with Anu, his wealthy wife's secretary. When the wife finds out, they kill her. The police then find evidence against him, and he learns that Anu is likely to betray him.

programme.title: Main Hoon Chaalbaaz
programme.desc: Gudumba Shankar falls in love with Gowri and finds out that she is being forced to marry Kumar Swamy, a gangster. Shankar must find a way to stop him and save Gowri.

programme.title: Jagan
programme.desc: Jagan, an artist by profession, befriends two siblings on separate occasions and they both fall in love with him. He is forcibly married to the elder sister by goons, creating troubles in his life.

programme.title: Anari Ishq
programme.desc: Rama, a simpleton, is appointed as the bodyguard of Rajnandini, a rich girl. She soon falls in love with him but her brothers' violent nature gets in the way of her uniting with Rama.

programme.title: Nakshatra
programme.desc: Ajay works on a new script, which is based on a robbery of an expensive necklace, for some producers. However, things take a turn when the scene is enacted in real-life and the blame falls on Ajay.

programme.title: Aaj Ka Mahaatma
programme.desc: Randhir, a straightforward and hardworking man, sets out to avenge the death of his twin brother Ranvir, a criminal, who was murdered by a prison inmate.

programme.title: Samay-when the time strikes
programme.desc: ACP Malvika Chauhan, a widowed mother, is assigned to investigate the murder of a businessman. However, she suspects it to be a serial killer as more murders take place in the city.

programme.title: Saajan Ki Saheli
programme.desc: Kunti abandons her baby in order to lead a lavish life and marries a rich man. Years later, she realises that her husband is indulging in an affair and is shocked to find out the truth about the girl.

programme.title: Ek Lahoo
programme.desc: Ashok and Lakshmi share an ideal brother-sister relationship. They find their perfect matches and lead a happily married life until Ashok's wife's aunt comes into their life and creates mayhem.

programme.title: Kehte Hain Muzko Raaja
programme.desc: Action Movie.

programme.title: Ishq Ki Aag
programme.desc: Priyanka, a rich and studious girl, despises Raghu, a student in her college. Problems arise when she develops feelings for him but he falls in love with Aarthi, his classmate.

programme.title: Azad Desh Ka Andha Kanoon
programme.desc: A brash and honest policeman is torn apart between his duties and saving his family when his own brother is caught in a blue-film scam. He also must protect a sole witness whose life is in danger.

programme.title: Karishma Kudrat Ka
programme.desc: Widower Vijay lives in a village with his family. He unwittingly makes an enemy in Lala and a bandit, Bhagad, who conspire and throw him out of the village. But Vijay soon returns as a changed man.

programme.title: Haisiyat
programme.desc: Union leader Ram is also married to his boss. When there is a conflict between the management and the workers, Ram must decide if his duty lies towards his wife or towards his union and the workers.

programme.title: Alag
programme.desc: Tejas, an odd boy who grew up in a basement, is moved to a rehabilitation centre after his father's death. When he starts displaying psychic powers, a scientist abducts him for experimentation.

programme.title: Hiraasat
programme.desc: ACP Ashok Saxena is an honest middle-class police officer who lives with his wife, Shobha, and college-going brother, Rajesh. However, he is framed in a case of drug-trafficking and gets arrested.

programme.title: Rustum
programme.desc: ACP Abhishek Bhargav is determined to find the culprits behind the death of his friend, DCP Bharath. His investigation takes him to Bangalore, where he uncovers revelations of an organ trade mafia.

programme.title: Salta Diya
programme.desc: A rich man's wife and a thief's wife simultaneously give birth to twin sons, from which two of them get exchanged. Years later, an unexpected event leads them to swap places once again.

programme.title: Love Mocktail
programme.desc: After rescuing a woman, Adi reminisces about his love life and tells her about all the heartbreaks he endured in his quest to find his true love.

programme.title: Pyar Ki Kahani
programme.desc: Ram, a peon, forms a close friendship with a man named Ravi and values his opinion. However, he is shocked when Ravi disapproves of his fiancee and gets more upset when he learns the reason why.

programme.title: Pighalta Aasman
programme.desc: Delhi-based businesswoman Arti Singh travels to Kashmir to claim her land from Suraj Arora. Soon after Arti and Suraj fall in love with each other, she learns that her friend Anu too loves him.

programme.title: Main Intequam Loonga
programme.desc: Kumar learns that his father, a national level boxing champion, was killed when he refused to lose a fight. He vows to annihilate his father's killers, unaware that he may face tragic consequences.

programme.title: Josh
programme.desc: Max, who lives with his twin sister Shirley in Goa, is enraged when he finds out that she has fallen in love with Rahul, his bitter rival Prakash's younger brother.

programme.title: Pyar Ke Kabil
programme.desc: Kiran and Jyoti are twins who were separated after their parents uncoupled. Years later, they meet accidentally at a picnic and decide to exchange places in an effort to reunite their parents.

programme.title: Action Time
programme.desc: Vedha and his daughter Kanaka are on a killing spree. They are being chased by a cop Rama, but they always manage to escape in the nick of time. Can Rama stop the killings?

programme.title: Biwi.Com
programme.desc: When a pandit predicts that Kishan will marry thrice in his lifetime, his wife Shilpa forces him into a second marriage. When the wives start fighting, a third woman arrives from London for Kishan.

programme.title: Love Mocktail 2
programme.desc: With the semblance of leading a normal life, Adi struggles with the loss of his wife, Nidhi. However, Sihi, a charming young woman, enters as a glimmer of hope when she commits to helping Adi.

programme.title: Farz
programme.desc: Gopal, a secret agent, investigates the death of his colleague who possessed evidence against a known terrorist. Gopal and Kamla embark on a journey to find the traitor.

programme.title: Mast
programme.desc: Kittu is madly in love with Malika, an actress, and travels to her house in Mumbai from Pune after his father scolds him for his decreasing exam scores.

programme.title: Ghatak
programme.desc: When Kashi visits a community with his father, he is shocked to see the torturous regime of Katya. He tries to oppose Katya, but ends up compromising the safety of his family and relatives.

programme.title: Nazar Ke Samne
programme.desc: Jai, an unemployed drunk, gives false testimony that puts an innocent man in jail for murder. However, he later relents and tries to exonerate him by searching for the real killer.

programme.title: Shehzaade
programme.desc: Suraj, a justice-loving man, must face a series of obstacles when he discovers his widowed mother's affair with a former prisoner.

programme.title: Kundan
programme.desc: Shamsher Singh, who is involved in criminal activities, decides to get the better of Kundan, a police officer, after realising that he is a threat to him.

programme.title: Bloody Mary
programme.desc: In an attempt to fulfill their dreams, three friends get entangled in trouble related to a director's death. Meanwhile, they confront an inspector while trying to save themselves.

programme.title: Dhongee
programme.desc: Chandran lies to his boss that his mother is unwell to get a leave but gets caught. In order to save his job, he is forced to pretend to his boss that he has a good-for-nothing twin brother.

programme.title: Sikandar Sadak Ka
programme.desc: Sikander, an honest union worker, is harassed and sent to jail when he tries to stop the unscrupulous activities of his evil employer. After he gets released, he sets out to destroy him.

programme.title: Gurudev
programme.desc: Inspector Dev Kumar has to choose between arresting his childhood friend Guru's father, who is a notorious criminal, and his integrity.

programme.title: International Crook
programme.desc: Rajesh, a superintendent of the police, is happy to meet his old friend Shekar in Goa, unaware that he is a smuggler who is involved in a spree of illegal activities.

programme.title: Sikka
programme.desc: Vijay and Pranlal, two close friends, decide to marry off their kin in a bid to cement their friendship. Soon, Vijay learns about Pranlal's illegal activities and calls off the wedding.

programme.title: Ajab Gazabb Love
programme.desc: Rajveer, a rich man, falls in love with Madhuri. However, he soon realises that she detests affluent people and in order to win her heart, he, along with his family, pretends to be poor.

programme.title: Guddu Ki Gun
programme.desc: Guddu, a salesman, lands in dire trouble when his girlfriend's grandfather casts a spell on him for cheating on her. However, he must find true love to get rid of the curse.

programme.title: Pithamagan
programme.desc: An imposter befriends a social outcast convicted in a drug-peddling case in prison. However, when they are released from jail, they get entangled in a local drug lord's vicious scheme.

programme.title: Rustum
programme.desc: ACP Abhishek Bhargav is determined to find the culprits behind the death of his friend, DCP Bharath. His investigation takes him to Bangalore, where he uncovers revelations of an organ trade mafia.

programme.title: Anokhi Ada
programme.desc: Lalaji and Gupta, two business partners, take their relationship to the next level when their children, Rakesh and Neeta, marry each other. However, chaos ensues when Lalaji helps Gopal, a stranger.

programme.title: Avinash
programme.desc: Avinash, a singer and a dealer of stolen goods, finds his life turned upside down when some goons break into his house and assault his fiancee.

programme.title: Wafadaar
programme.desc: Chanda's parents disapprove of her boyfriend Ranga and want her to marry Prasad. Ranga is accused of having an affair with Sita. Chanda faces turmoil in her life.

programme.title: Zakhmi Aurat
programme.desc: Inspector Kiran Dutt is brutally raped by Sukhdev and Suryakant. When they are acquitted by the court due to lack of evidence, she decides to take the law in her own hands.

programme.title: Mera Karam Mera Dharam
programme.desc: Ajay, a businessman, provides funds to Sarjuprasad to develop his hometown. When he learns that the money has been misappropriated by Sarjuprasad, he resolves to set things right.

programme.title: Ranbanka
programme.desc: Rahul, an ordinary engineer, comes to Mathura with his wife and son. However, when a gangster gets attracted to his wife and forces her to marry him, he tries to find a way to stop his advances.

programme.title: Shivam
programme.desc: When Nalla and Aras get stranded at the airport, Aras tries to keep away from the man with a deformity. However, while forcefully accompanying each other to Chennai, they form an unexpected bond.

programme.title: Blood Relation
programme.desc: Full of action and drama.

programme.title: Buniyad
programme.desc: he storyline involves a vengeful ex-convict who attempts to start a new life and deals with a "wicked woman" who tries to destroy the lives of those around him.

programme.title: Teri Kasam
programme.desc: Dolly, a rich and spoilt woman, falls for Tony, a poor musician, and marries him. However, her arrogance begins to create problems in their marital life.

programme.title: 15th August
programme.desc: Nagpal kills Chaudhry and his son, Ram, a military officer. Chaudhry's second son, Vikram, vows to destroy Nagpal who is all set to become the Chief Minister on the upcoming Indian Independence Day.

programme.title: Apartment
programme.desc: Preeti, an air hostess, is tired of her unfaithful boyfriend and decides to throw him out of the house. To share the rent, she finds a roommate who appears to be a simple girl but has her own agenda.

programme.title: Jaan Se Pyaara
programme.desc: Inspector Jai arrests Guman only to release him after he threatens to destroy the city. Later, Jai's brother, who has a cognitive disability, gets abducted in return for a mysterious bag.

programme.title: China Gate
programme.desc: Colonel Puri requests his former fellow army officers court-martialed in disgrace to redeem themselves by rescuing a village from Jageera, an evil bandit.

programme.title: Professor

programme.title: Jaane Bhi Do Yaaro

programme.title: Gold Divers
programme.desc: Closing The Gap. Winter winds force the captains to reassess risk and reward. Shawn's mega-barge extraction worsens, and Ken pushes the Myrtle to the limit on a five-day run. S7, Ep8

programme.title: Aussie Gold Hunters
programme.desc: To increase gold production, the Gold Devils attempt to run three machines at once. The Gold Retrievers set a one-week ultimatum to find 10 ounces of gold. S8, Ep16

programme.title: Building Off The Grid
programme.desc: Dakota A-Frame. A man showcases off-grid luxury by building a home in the hills of South Dakota. This all-solar-powered abode will have a wood-burning fireplace and gourmet kitchen. S2, Ep9

programme.title: Building Off The Grid
programme.desc: Passive River House. A pro builder builds an off-grid home on a remote riverside plot on Canada's east coast. He faces tropical storms and winter blizzards during construction. S2, Ep10

programme.title: Deadliest Catch
programme.desc: Blow Up. While a routine rescue for the coast guard becomes a battle against the elements, fatigue aboard the Northwestern is causing her crew to make mistakes. S4, Ep10

programme.title: Treasure Quest: Snake Island
programme.desc: A Steep Price. A discovery on the island fires up the team. But as excitement builds, some dangerous encounters threaten to end the mission - and people's lives. S1, Ep3

programme.title: Expedition Unknown
programme.desc: Lasseter's Gold. Josh Gates sets off deep into the Australian Outback. He follows the footsteps of legendary explorer Harold Lasseter, who claims to have found a vast field of gold. S3, Ep8

programme.title: Expedition Unknown
programme.desc: Tracking Tasmania's Tiger. Josh ventures to Australia's island state of Tasmania. He investigates sightings of the supposedly extinct Thylacine, also known as the Tasmanian Tiger. S3, Ep9

programme.title: Homestead Rescue: Raney Ranch
programme.desc: Count Your Blessings. The frozen access road to the Upper 20 becomes impassable, so Marty devises a risky way to transport massive equipment up the 300-foot icy cliff. S1, Ep11

programme.title: Homestead Rescue: Raney Ranch
programme.desc: Dead Of Winter. With several critical projects to complete, the Raneys face a season-ending winter storm. The family rushes to make the cabin liveable through winter. S1, Ep12

programme.title: Outback Opal Hunters
programme.desc: One Plus One Equals Three. Rod, Sam and Ben use their last dig of the season to secure enough opal for Les' retirement. Cody almost meets his demise down a 10-metre mine shaft. S7, Ep20

programme.title: Opal Hunters Red Dirt Road Trip

programme.title: Aussie Gold Hunters
programme.desc: Marcus and Linden fear a flat battery could leave them stuck in the outback for days. Plus, Shane and Russell attempt to get their season on track. S5, Ep8

programme.title: The Repair Shop
programme.desc: Deep in the countryside, expert restorers take in Britain's broken and battered artefacts and bring them back to life while learning the rich history of the objects.

programme.title: How Do They Do It?
programme.desc: How do they run Ryker's Island, one of the biggest jails in the world? How do they make the famous Royal Mail post box? And how do they turn fruit into jam?

programme.title: How Do They Do It?
programme.desc: How do they make playing cards that can defeat a cheat? How do they brew a billion bottles of lager a year? And how do they make the world's most luxurious private jets?

programme.title: How Do They Do It?
programme.desc: How do they put the holes in Swiss cheese? How do they restore and improve a classic battle tank? And how do robotic librarians run one of the world's biggest book collections?

programme.title: How Do They Do It?
programme.desc: How do they persuade an oyster to grow a perfect pearl? How do they put the twist in classic Pennsylvania pretzels? And how do they build Venice's traditional gondolas?

programme.title: Salvage Hunters
programme.desc: Rare Survivors. Serkan and Jay visit a Victorian steam museum, while Serkan and Alister Dryburgh get to trawl through storage containers at a Kent country house.

programme.title: Salvage Hunters
programme.desc: Provenance Counts. Serkan, Jay and Viki hunt for items with remarkable history. In Somerset they visit a family-run quarry, and a collection of circus artefacts.

programme.title: Salvage Hunters: Classic Cars
programme.desc: VW Beetle Karmann Cabriolet. Paul and Drew take on their biggest restoration yet, a VW Beetle Karmann Cabriolet. The car is in terrible condition, but Drew is determined to save it.

programme.title: How It's Made
programme.desc: More everyday items are put under the microscope as we discover how they are made, including levels, hot dogs, abrasive grains and sandpaper.

programme.title: How It's Made
programme.desc: More everyday items are put under the microscope as we discover how they are made, including ice cream treats, wooden golf clubs and aircraft wings.

programme.title: Teleshopping

programme.title: Teleshopping

programme.title: Salvage Hunters: The Restorers
programme.desc: Automata Acrobatics. Automata artisans Michael and Maria restore an acrobatic figurine from France. Meanwhile, sculptor Nick revives a pair of fairground ride motorbikes.

programme.title: Salvage Hunters
programme.desc: Branching Out. Drew heads to a Kent antiques emporium specialising in unusual European antiques, and indulges in 1940s nostalgia at a home front museum in South West Wales.

programme.title: Salvage Hunters
programme.desc: Balbithan. Drew goes North of the border on a road trip for an epic private house clearance in a remote part of Scotland, and he visits a historic cutlery factory in Sheffield.

programme.title: Aussie Gold Hunters
programme.desc: The Poseidon Crew receive devastating news about their mining permits. The Dust Devils gamble big on a quartz reef. Shane and Russell strike gold.

programme.title: Aussie Gold Hunters
programme.desc: A new crew are under threat from crocodiles and accusations of illegal prospecting. The Victoria Diggers receive some welcome help.

programme.title: Outback Opal Hunters
programme.desc: In Deep. The Boulder Boys drain floodwater in search of opals. Rod Manning is under pressure after using his wife's favourite opal ring as collateral.

programme.title: Outback Opal Hunters
programme.desc: Machines. The Blacklighters must relocate Opalzilla after their claim runs dry of opal. The Cheals hope to hit the jackpot in a bizarre structure, the Z-fault.

programme.title: Salvage Hunters
programme.desc: Drew and Tee are excited by the items on offer at the largest antiques market in Italy. And, they visit a picturesque town in Spain to look at a fascinating collection.

programme.title: Shed And Buried: Classic Cars
programme.desc: Ford Transit. Henry and Fuzz visit Warwickshire to revive a battered Ford Transit. Once a workhorse of Britain, now a rusted relic longing for a second life.

programme.title: Shed And Buried
programme.desc: Graham Steeler. Henry and Fuzz head to Southend to visit Graham's shed full of bikes and muscle cars. They find a Dutton kit car and rows and rows of rare bikes.

programme.title: Shed And Buried
programme.desc: Will Ralph. Henry and Fuzz visit a farm near Colchester with vintage tractors galore. The boys come away with a classic Fordson and some old traffic lights.

programme.title: Sherlock Holmes: Murder by Decree
programme.desc: 1979. Crime. Director: Bob Clark. Stars: Christopher Plummer, James Mason & David Hemmings. Holmes investigates Jack the Ripper's murders and discovers a conspiracy to protect the killer.

programme.title: The Appointment
programme.desc: 1981. Horror. Director: Lindsey C. Vickers. Stars Edward Woodward, Jane Merrow & Samantha Weysom. Ian misses his daughter's concert so he will have to contend with more than just childish sulking.

programme.title: The Strange Love of Martha Ivers
programme.desc: 1946. Drama. Director: Lewis Milestone. Stars Barbara Stanwyck, Van Heflin, Lizabeth Scott & Kirk Douglas. The relationships formed in childhood by three friends lead to murder and obsessive love.

programme.title: Look At Life The Village Sleeps Again
programme.desc: 1962. A look at the arguments for and against building by-passes, featuring Transport Minister Ernest Marples. With a look at the by-passes being built and the effects on small towns and villages.

programme.title: Stagecoach West
programme.desc: The Renegades. Wayne Rogers & Robert Bray run a stagecoach line in the Old West, where they come across a wide variety of killers, robbers and ladies in distress.

programme.title: Batman
programme.desc: Hizzonner the Penguin. 1966. Stars Adam West & Burgess Meredith. Suspiciously endearing himself to the citizens of Gotham by foiling a robbery, the Penguin announces he is running for mayor.

programme.title: Batman
programme.desc: Dizzonner the Penguin. 1966. Stars Adam West, Burgess Meredith & Woodrow Parfrey. The Penguin kidnaps members of the election board in an attempt to sway the votes to become mayor in his favour.

programme.title: The Directors
programme.desc: Alfred Hitchcock defined his own unique style of filmmaking from the early days of the 39 Steps and the Lodger to the Hollywood glamour of North by Northwest.

programme.title: Stock Car
programme.desc: 1955. Drama. After the death of her father while motor racing, the daughter (Rona Anderson) is dissuaded from selling his garage by fellow racer Larry (Paul Carpenter) who helps her run it.

programme.title: Liz Fraser
programme.desc: Desert Mice. Talking Pictures was fortunate to film with Liz Fraser and discuss her life in film a few years ago. Here she talks exclusively to Robert Ross.

programme.title: Desert Mice
programme.desc: 1959. Comedy. Set in WW2, this is the story of an ENSA troupe of entertainers. Starring Sid James, Dora Bryan, Alfred Marks and Liz Fraser.

programme.title: Love In Pawn
programme.desc: 1953. Comedy. Penniless couple Roger (Bernard Braden) and Jean (Barbara Kelly) will get £10,000 if Roger can live a sober and profitable life. Starring Reg Dixon and John Laurie.

programme.title: So Long at the Fair
programme.desc: 1950. Mystery. Directors: Antony Darnborough & Terence Fisher. Stars Jean Simmons & Dirk Bogarde. Two siblings visit Paris for the Great Exhibition of 1889 when one of them goes missing.

programme.title: The Duchess of Duke Street
programme.desc: One Night's Grace. 1976. Stars Gemma Jones, Christopher Cazenove & Sally Osborne. Everyone is intrigued when an attractive young lady asks to see Lord Haslemere. Who is she and what is she after?

programme.title: The End of the Affair
programme.desc: 1955. Drama. Director: Edward Dmytryk. Stars Deborah Kerr, Van Johnson & John Mills. In WW2 London, a writer falls in love with the wife of a civil servant. Both men suspect her of infidelity.

programme.title: Whispering Smith Hits London
programme.desc: 1952. Mystery. Director: Francis Searle. Stars Richard Carlson, Greta Gynt & Herbert Lom. US sleuth Whispering Smith arrives in London on holiday but soon becomes embroiled in a murder case.

programme.title: Weir's Way
programme.desc: An Edinburgh Volcano. 1981. Tom visits Arthur's Seat in Edinburgh, the most studied volcano in the world and where the very beginnings of geology were laid by Edinburgh geologist James Hutton.

programme.title: The Brothers
programme.desc: The Guilt Beneath the Gingerbread. 1974. Stars Richard Easton, Bill Treacher & Timothy Carlton. Brian finds himself alone to answer police questioning. Meanwhile, unrest at the depot continues.

programme.title: Mark Saber
programme.desc: Man About To Die. 1958. Stars Donald Gray & Neil McCallum. The hero of a children's sci-fi programme on television is a man without enemies, or so he thinks until someone threatens his life.

programme.title: The Wheeltappers and Shunters Social Club
programme.desc: Episode 25. 1975. Julie Rogers performs 'My World Gets Smaller Every Day', and Wild Honey perform 'I Can't Leave You Alone'. Plus, Dustin Gee, Ronnie Dukes and Ricki Lee star.

programme.title: Lord Jim
programme.desc: 1965. Adventure. Directed by Richard Brooks. Stars James Mason, Peter O'Toole & Curt Jurgens. A discredited seaman, desperately seeking to redeem himself, agrees to deliver a dangerous shipment.

programme.title: Up The Chastity Belt
programme.desc: 1971. Comedy. Director: Bob Kellett. Stars: Frankie Howerd, Eartha Kitt, Anna Quayle, Roy Hudd. Lurkalot is a serf who sells chastity belts and love potions at the local market place.

programme.title: A Home of Your Own
programme.desc: 1965. Comedy. Directed by Jay Lewis Stars Ronnie Barker, Peter Butterworth & Bernard Cribbins. A wordless, satirical look at British builders as they attempt to build a young couple's dream home.

programme.title: Sergeant Cork
programme.desc: The Case of the Knotted Scarf. 1963. Stars John Barrie, William Gaunt & Brewster Mason. A woman is found dead, strangled with a knotted scarf. Leaving behind a husband some 26 years her senior.

programme.title: Burke's Law
programme.desc: Who Killed Rosie Sunset? 1965. Stars Gene Barry, Gary Conway & Regis Toomey. A nice old lady has been murdered. Who and why would do such thing. She only sold maps of stars homes.

programme.title: Batman
programme.desc: Green Ice. 1966. Stars Adam West, Otto Preminger & Dee Hartford. Mr. Freeze kidnaps Miss Iceland from the Gotham City Beauty Contest to freeze her to 50 degrees below zero and marry her.

programme.title: Batman
programme.desc: Deep Freeze. 1966. Stars Adam West, Otto Preminger & Kem Dibbs. As public animosity mounts, Batman and Robin hang up their capes. Meanwhile, Mr. Freeze decides to blackmail Gotham City.

programme.title: The Secret Man
programme.desc: 1958. Thriller. Director: Ronald Kinnoch. Stars Marshall Thompson, John Loder & Henry Oscar. A physicist finds himself drawn into an investigation to track down a spy at his research station.

programme.title: Life In Emergency Ward 10
programme.desc: 1959. Drama. Based on the smash hit TV series about the daily life and the ups and downs of a hospital. Stars Michael Craig, Wilfred Hyde-White and Joan Sims.

programme.title: Railway Murders
programme.desc: The Guardsman. 2021. Stars Nicholas Day, Judith Rowbotham & Alan Moss. 28 year old Geoffrey Charles Dean was murdered by a railway fireman who stole £160 from the railway booking office.

programme.title: There Was a Young Lady
programme.desc: 1953. Comedy. Director: Lawrence Huntington. Stars Michael Denison, Dulcie Gray & Sydney Tafler. A diamond merchants' secretary gets fired by her new boss for being too efficient.

programme.title: The History Of Mr Polly
programme.desc: 1949. Drama. Director: Anthony Pelissier. Stars John Mills, Betty Ann Davies, Megs Jenkins, Moore Marriott & Finlay Currie. Alfred reluctantly uses inherited money on two big ventures.

programme.title: Camera Magic
programme.desc: 1947. A rarity from Castle Films when Eugene Castle was presumed to be in charge of operations. An insight behind the scenes of the 'magic making' of films and many 'tricks of the trade'.

programme.title: The Adventures of Robin Hood
programme.desc: The Thorkil Ghost. 1956. Stars Richard Greene, Victor Woolf & Barbara Mullen. A young man tells Robin of hidden treasure in a castle that his late father had an encounter with a Viking ghost.

programme.title: Carrie's War
programme.desc: 2004. Drama. Director: Coky Giedroyc. Stars Alun Armstrong, Geraldine McEwan & Jack Stanley. Carrie and her brother are evacuated to Wales where they meet friends who make their time delightful.

programme.title: The Cheaters
programme.desc: Knight of the Road. 1962. Stars John Ireland, Robert Ayres & Richard Vernon. Eastern Insurance pay £6,000 to Ken Northwood when his car is stolen but three other insurers have also paid out...

programme.title: A Family At War
programme.desc: 1971. Clash By Night. Creator: John Finch. Stars John McKelvey & Keith Drinkel. A still-blind Phillip encounters an old enemy who once shot one of his comrades in the Spanish Civil War. (S2, E16)

programme.title: Appointment In London
programme.desc: 1953. War. Director: Philip Leacock. Stars Dirk Bogarde, Ian Hunter & Dinah Sheridan. A strained British Wing Commander leads his squadron of Lancaster bombers into another dangerous mission.

programme.title: Public Eye
programme.desc: How About It, Frank? 1975. Detective & Mystery Drama. Stars Alfred Burke, Peter Childs & Ray McAnally. Ron Gash wants Marker as his new partner. But are Gash's methods compatible with Marker's?

programme.title: Cellar Club with Caroline Munro
programme.desc: Caroline Munro is down in The Cellar Club ready to whisk you away to Hong Kong with the 1974 film Shatter, a co-production by Hammer Films and Shaw Brothers Studio.

programme.title: Shatter
programme.desc: 1974. Action Drama. Director: Michael Carreras. Stars Stuart Whitman, Peter Cushing & Lung Ti. An international hitman is hiding out in Hong Kong after completing a contract on an African leader.

programme.title: Cellar Club with Caroline Munro
programme.desc: Caroline Munro asks you to don your rain macs and camel hair coats next week, to travel once again outside the confines of the Cellar Club for a very special live event.

programme.title: Sherlock Holmes: The Last Vampyre
programme.desc: 1993. Drama. Director: Tim Sullivan. Stars Jeremy Brett, Edward Hardwicke & Roy Marsden. Sherlock Holmes investigates strange and tragic happenings in a village where an unusual man resides.

programme.title: The Big Trees
programme.desc: 1952. Western. Directed by Felix E. Feist. Stars Kirk Douglas, Eve Miller & Patrice Wymore. A timber baron sets his sights on California's redwood trees but faces conflict with a Quaker colony.

programme.title: Fort Algiers
programme.desc: 1953. Drama. Director: Lesley Selander. Stars Yvonne De Carlo, Carlos Thompson & Raymond Burr. In northwest Africa, a tribal leader tries to stir up a rebellion against the ruling powers.

programme.title: About Bread
programme.desc: 1938. A short reel about the process of making bread from importing ingredients, to baking and distributing. Plus, the nutritional benefits for everyone that bread can provide.

programme.title: The Vise
programme.desc: Account Closed. 1955. Stars Ron Randell, Dennis Price & Helen Backlin. Harry Brandon gambles and fails on get rich quick schemes, until his wife is accused of theft and there is a finding fee.

programme.title: Batman
programme.desc: The Impractical Joker. 1966. Stars Adam West & Cesar Romero. The Joker vandalises a number of key objects around Gotham. Commissioner Gordon calls Batman and Robin to solve the enigmatic clues.

programme.title: Batman
programme.desc: The Joker's Provokers. 1966. Stars Adam West & Cesar Romero. While Batman and Robin attempt to free themselves, The Joker plans to take over Gotham City using a time machine and hallucinogens.

programme.title: Bombay Waterfront
programme.desc: 1952. Directed by Maclean Rogers and starring John Bentley, Patricia Dainton and Peter Gawthorne. Follows Temple's efforts to aid the police in solving a series of gruesome murders.

programme.title: Serena
programme.desc: 1962. Drama. Directed by Peter Maxwell. Stars Patrick Holt, Emrys Jones & Honor Blackman. An inspector strives to solve the mystery of an artist's dead wife. The artist becomes the main suspect.

programme.title: William Tell
programme.desc: Manhunt. 1959. Stars: Conrad Phillips, Willoughby Goddard & Jennifer Jayne. Trapped on an island owned by Prince Erik, a man who enjoys hunting prey, Tell's careers appears to be at the end.

programme.title: Object Z
programme.desc: The Meteor. 1965. Stars Margaret Neale, Denys Peek & Trevor Bannister. Scientists around the world announce that a meteor will hit Earth in six weeks.

programme.title: William at the Circus
programme.desc: Lost Cinema Serial - Episode 1. 1948. Stars William Graham, Garry Marsh & Jane Welsh. William Brown begins to devise a plan to secure more pay and shorter hours for schoolboys.

programme.title: Venture Adventure
programme.desc: 1941. A short film encouraging young men to enlist in the Army Training Corps, which was set up to train men in aviation skills, navigation and general duties for entry into the RAF.

programme.title: Hawkeye & the Last of the Mohicans
programme.desc: False Faces. 1957. Directed by Sam Newfield. Stars John Hart, Lon Chaney Jr & Bill Walsh. A series of thefts are falsely attributed to the innocent.

programme.title: The Lone Ranger
programme.desc: Pete and Petro. 1949. Stars: Clayton Moore, Jay Silverheels & Sheila Ryan. Pete and Pedro don't like working, until the Lone Ranger persuades them to help an attractive young woman save her ranch.

programme.title: Supercar
programme.desc: The Lost City. 1961. Stars David Graham, George Murcell & Graydon Gould. On the way to the South Pole, an uncontrolled force lands them on a strange island where they are in danger.

programme.title: The Adventures of Robin Hood
programme.desc: Highland Fling. 1957. Stars Richard Greene, Alexander Gauge & Hugh McDermott. King Richard sends Robin Hood and Friar Tuck on a mission to Scotland to collect a debt in the form of gold.

programme.title: Target Earth
programme.desc: 1954. Sci-Fi. Directed by Sherman A. Rose. Starring Richard Denning. A large city is ordered to be completely evacuated as an army of robots, believed to be from the planet Venus, attack it.

programme.title: Gift Horse
programme.desc: 1952. Director: Compton Bennett. Stars Trevor Howard, Richard Attenborough, Sonny Tufts. In 1940, the Captain of an old Royal Navy destroyer struggles with his crew, as well as the Nazis.

programme.title: Scales of Justice
programme.desc: 1965. The Material Witness. Stars Edgar Lustgarten & John Carlin. A young executive plots to replace a firm's manager, and turns him in to police as a drunk driver. (S1, E09)

programme.title: Call Northside 777
programme.desc: 1948. Drama. Directed by Henry Hathaway. Stars James Stewart, Richard Conte & Helen Walker. A Chicago reporter looks into an old murder and realises the man jailed for the crime is innocent.

programme.title: Dick Turpin
programme.desc: The King's Shilling. 1982. Stars Richard O'Sullivan & Ken Wynne. Swiftnick helps two lads who have been tricked into joining the King's army. The recruiting officers double back to get revenge.

programme.title: Maigret
programme.desc: The Liars. 1961. Stars Rupert Davies, Ewen Solon & Joseph Furst. Maigret travels to a coastal village to investigate the murder of the postmistress, with the schoolmaster being the main suspect.

programme.title: Lillie
programme.desc: Bertie. 1978. Stars Francesca Annis, Denis Lill & Ann Firbank. As Lillie acquires more admirers, her old friends see less of her, and she begins planning for the end of the season.

programme.title: Unfaithfully Yours
programme.desc: 1984. Comedy. Directed by Howard Zieff. Stars Dudley Moore, Nastassja Kinski & Armand Assante. An orchestra conductor believes that his wife is cheating on him and concocts a plan to murder her.

programme.title: Confessions from a Holiday Camp
programme.desc: 1977. Comedy. Directed by Norman Cohen. Stars Anthony Booth, Robin Askwith & Bill Maynard. Holiday camp employees enjoy their summer celebrations until a new manager arrives to spoil the fun.

programme.title: EuroTrash
programme.desc: 1998. Hosted by Antoine de Caunes. We meet a Spanish siren with castanets, meet Finland's biggest slappers, Lolo dives deep down with her snorkel and one man goes down in medical history.

programme.title: Yanky Panky
programme.desc: 2000. Join country music persona Tina C as she uncovers the eccentric subcultures, bizarre personalities, and the rude, crude and lewd underbelly of American society.

programme.title: The Hitch-Hiker
programme.desc: 1953. Thriller. Director Ida Lupino. Stars Edmond O'Brien, Frank Lovejoy & William Talman. Ray & Gilbert's fishing trip takes a turn when they pick up a hitch-hiker who turns out to be on the run.

programme.title: The Day Time Ended
programme.desc: 1979. Sci-Fi. Director: John Cardos. Stars Jim Davis, Christopher Mitchum & Dorothy Malone. Aliens visit the house of a family. The house is sucked into a time warp that sends it back in time.

programme.title: One Step Beyond

programme.title: Love, Sex Aur Dhokha 2
programme.desc: Three interconnected tales follow different people navigating the murky waters of human intimacy, sexual discovery, personal identity, and modern romance inside a hyper-connected, digital world.

programme.title: Kisi Ka Bhai Kisi Ki Jaan
programme.desc: Bhaijaan, the eldest brother, stays unmarried to keep peace in the family. But things get complicated when his younger brothers secretly try to make him fall in love.

programme.title: Aa Ab Laut Chalen
programme.desc: Rohan Khanna moves to the US for work and finds himself torn between Pooja and Loveleen. Eventually, he realises his heart belongs to Pooja and returns to her.

programme.title: Pure Bollywood
programme.desc: Bollywood songs - catchy, emotional, and upbeat - dominate the charts. From heartbreak to celebration, these tracks capture every mood, making people dance, cry, and sing along everywhere.

programme.title: The Bhootnii
programme.desc: Heartbroken Shantanu seeks true love under the Virgin Tree, but things spiral when Mohabbat, a lovestruck ghost, begins obsessing over him and turns his life upside down.

programme.title: Naseeb Apna Apna
programme.desc: A controlling father forces his son into marrying a simple rural bride, who moves to the city only to discover her new husband secretly shares another home with someone else.

programme.title: Satyaprem Ki Katha
programme.desc: Sattu, a failed lawyer, dreams of marrying Katha, a girl out of his league. Fate unites them, and Sattu tries to win her love with sincerity.

programme.title: Doodh Ka Karz
programme.desc: Falsely accused of theft, a snake charmer is beaten to death by landlords. His wife, Parvati, raises their son Suraj, who sets out with his loyal snake to avenge his father's murder.

programme.title: Chitchor
programme.desc: (Movies @6) Geeta's father mistakenly brings home the wrong groom. As love unexpectedly blossoms, a letter arrives that changes everything for the newly formed couple.

programme.title: Tezaab
programme.desc: After his parents' murder, Mahesh is imprisoned and separated from Mohini, who suffers under her cruel father. Years later, he returns to rescue her and avenge his past.

programme.title: Phool Aur Kante
programme.desc: Ajay, the son of a crime boss, lives peacefully until rivals kidnap his father. Forced into the underworld, he must confront danger and fight to save his family.

programme.title: Iqbal
programme.desc: Iqbal, a hearing- and speech-impaired boy, dreams of playing for India. When his condition blocks his selection, he turns to a retired coach to train him for his dream.

programme.title: Raazi
programme.desc: Sehmat Khan, a brave RAW agent, marries into a Pakistani family at her father's request. Her mission is dangerous-gathering crucial enemy secrets while risking her life.

programme.title: Mili
programme.desc: Mili Naudiyal works in a restaurant while preparing to move to Canada. Her life turns into a survival battle when she's accidentally locked inside a freezer.

programme.title: Judaai
programme.desc: Driven by greed, Kajal urges her honest husband Raj to marry his boss's wealthy daughter Janhvi, but her plan triggers unforeseen consequences that threaten their lives.

programme.title: Biwi Ho To Aisi
programme.desc: Suraj secretly marries Shalu, a village belle, defying his domineering mother Kamla. To drive Shalu away, Kamla falsely accuses her of stealing jewellery and money.

programme.title: Sholay
programme.desc: (Movies @6) Thakur Baldev hires Jai and Veeru to capture Gabbar, the dacoit who wiped out his family. They find love along the way, but fate decides otherwise.

programme.title: Jodi No.1
programme.desc: Partners in crime Jai and Veeru set their next target on a rich businessman, Rai Bahadur. Things turn hilarious when they both fall for his daughters.

programme.title: Odela 2
programme.desc: In a remote village with rich traditions, the savior Odela Mallanna Swamy always protects his people from evil forces.

programme.title: Love Hostel
programme.desc: Amidst bloodshed, deception, and desperate escapes, Jyothi and Ashu elope, prompting her family to hire a ruthless mercenary to hunt them down and end their love.

programme.title: Dabangg
programme.desc: Chulbul Pandey, a fearless cop, fights corruption his own way. Cheddi Singh creates a rift with his step-brother, exploiting it for power, forcing Chulbul to battle enemies inside and outside.

programme.title: Khoon Bhari Mang
programme.desc: Widowed Aarti is trapped in Sanjay's devious marriage plot. With Nandini's help, he tries to drown her and steal her wealth, but she survives and rises to seek revenge.

programme.title: Vanvaas
programme.desc: An elderly father abandoned by his sons and struggling with fading memory begins a heartfelt journey, guided by a clever wanderer determined to reunite him with his family.

programme.title: Kasme Vaade
programme.desc: Raju, guilt-ridden over his brother's death, meets Amit's lookalike, Shankar, and unknowingly becomes entangled in a deeper mystery, making amends while facing unsettling truths.

programme.title: Saturday Blockbuster- Phool Aur Kante
programme.desc: Ajay, the son of a crime boss, lives peacefully until rivals kidnap his father. Forced into the underworld, he must confront danger and fight to save his family.

programme.title: De De Pyaar De 2
programme.desc: Ashish Mehra, a London-based NRI investor, visits his girlfriend's family, but tensions escalate when her father discovers the truth about Ashish's real age.

programme.title: B.A.Pass 2
programme.desc: A young woman escapes an arranged marriage and moves to Mumbai. Alone in the big city, she faces the tough world of showbiz and discovers the real meaning of life and love.

programme.title: Rashmi Rocket
programme.desc: A small-town girl rises to become a national athlete, breaking barriers. Her glory is shattered when she's forced into a humiliating gender test, challenging her dreams.

programme.title: Pure Bollywood
programme.desc: Bollywood songs - catchy, emotional, and upbeat - dominate the charts. From heartbreak to celebration, these tracks capture every mood, making people dance, cry, and sing along everywhere.

programme.title: Mere Pyaare Prime Minister
programme.desc: Kannu, an eight-year-old boy, writes to India's prime minister after his mother is raped. With two friends, he journeys from Mumbai to Delhi, bravely seeking justice.

programme.title: Kaho Naa Pyar Hai
programme.desc: After Rohit's mysterious death, Sonia relocates to New Zealand to heal. There, she meets Raj-Rohit's lookalike-who helps her uncover the truth behind Rohit's murder.

programme.title: Air India Around The World- Dil Chahta Hai
programme.desc: Three inseparable friends drift apart after college-Akash moves to Australia, Sameer chases love, and Siddharth immerses in art-each following a different path.

programme.title: No Entry
programme.desc: Kishan, a loyal husband, disapproves of his friend Prem's infidelity. But when introduced to Bobby, a prostitute, Kishan's morals are tested, leading to complications, secrets, and unexpected choices.

programme.title: Mega Double Premiere- Bhoot Bangla
programme.desc: Arjun inherits his family's haunted estate in rural Mangalpur and hosts his sister Meera's wedding there, accidentally unleashing supernatural forces linked to their dark ancestral legacy.

programme.title: Bhoot Bangla
programme.desc: (Extended version) Arjun inherits his family's haunted estate in rural Mangalpur and hosts his sister Meera's wedding there, accidentally unleashing supernatural forces linked to their dark ancestral.

programme.title: Zeher
programme.desc: Siddharth, a police officer facing divorce, begins an affair with Anna. When she's found dead, he realises he's entangled in a dangerous mystery beyond his control.

programme.title: Krazzy 4
programme.desc: A doctor takes four intellectually disabled patients to a cricket match but gets kidnapped. The four team up with a TV channel girl to find and rescue her.

programme.title: Bareilly Ki Barfi
programme.desc: In Bareilly, free-spirited Bitti defies marriage pressures until her life changes when she meets Chirag and Pritam, sparking unexpected adventures and romance.

programme.title: Koi Mil Gaya
programme.desc: Rohit, a mentally challenged youth, befriends an alien. When police discover the creature, they try to capture it, while Rohit bravely protects his extraordinary friend against all odds.

programme.title: Ek Deewane ki Deewaniyat
programme.desc: When a powerful politician falls for a strong-willed superstar, their intense romance spirals into a perilous clash of desire and ego, turning love into a battle of passion and heartbreak.

programme.title: Yamla Pagla Deewana 2
programme.desc: Dharam and Gajodhar, a father-son duo, pose as owners of a huge company to con a business tycoon, but things spiral when Gajodhar's brother joins the scheme.

programme.title: Singh Is King
programme.desc: (Movies @6) Happy, known for his wild antics, is sent to bring Lakhan to his ailing father. In Australia, events take a turn as Happy accidentally assumes Lakhan's role as the local underworld king.

programme.title: Super Singh
programme.desc: Super Singh, a carefree man living with his mother in Canada, gains superpowers and returns to Punjab to battle drug lords and corrupt politicians threatening his homeland.

programme.title: Saaho
programme.desc: An undercover agent and his partner chase a thief who stole 2,000 crore. Soon, they uncover links to a crime lord's death and a brewing gang war.

programme.title: Raksha Bandhan
programme.desc: The eldest brother of four sisters, a humble chaat seller, struggles to honor his ailing mother's wish while steadfastly protecting their family's values and dignity.

programme.title: Taal
programme.desc: Mansi rises to fame with Vikrant's help after being insulted. But when her ex apologises and wants her back, she must choose between past pain and present success.

programme.title: Radhe: Your Most Wanted Bhai
programme.desc: Radhe, a fearless Mumbai Police encounter specialist, takes on a ruthless drug lord. His mission is dangerous, but his determination to end crime drives him through battles and chaos.

programme.title: Bombay To Goa
programme.desc: Mala, a young woman who witnesses a murder, flees on a Goa-bound bus. Along the way, she meets colourful travellers from different cultures and a spirited young man who refuses to leave her side.

programme.title: Gadar-Ek Prem Katha
programme.desc: During the partition, Tara marries Sakina, living happily together. Their joy ends when Sakina's father forces her to remain in Pakistan, separating her from Tara and her family forever.

programme.title: A Flying Jatt
programme.desc: (Movies @6) Aman, a martial arts teacher, gains superpowers during a fight with Raka. But Raka becomes stronger after toxic exposure, and Aman must defeat him to save others.

programme.title: Kesari
programme.desc: Havildar Ishar Singh leads 21 brave Sikh soldiers against 10,000 Pashtun invaders, creating one of history's greatest last stands of courage and sacrifice.

programme.title: Koi Mil Gaya
